sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins before a recent draw, while Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches and are winless in their last five outings. Sandbach will be strongly favored to extend their unbeaten run in this home fixture.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a key fixture that could see them close the 2-point gap at the summit. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall (fifth, 18 points) in a battle between two strong mid-table sides. Wolverhampton Casuals (fourth, 19 points) welcome Wednesfield Community (ninth, 13 points) in a fixture between adjacent league positions. In-form Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) host Foley Meir (13th, 11 points), while Barnton (seventh, 15 points) face Shawbury United (15th, 10 points), who are struggling with five consecutive defeats. New Mills (eighth, 14 points) travel to Market Drayton Town (10th, 12 points). Crewe (16th, 9 points) entertain Allscott Heath (11th, 11 points), while Brereton Social (14th, 11 points) host struggling Widnes Town (20th, 2 points), and Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th, 7 points) travel to Telford Town (18th, 6 points).
